title: Wealth and the Rich
lead: The Bible calls wealth a gift of God and also one of the strongest temptations to forget him. The prophets, Jesus and James warn the rich who trust in riches and oppress the poor.

sections.b: Abraham, Job and Solomon are rich by God's blessing (Genesis 13:2; Job 42:12; 1 Kings 3:13), and Deuteronomy 8:18 says God gives the power to get wealth. Yet Deuteronomy 8:11–14 warns that plenty leads people to forget the LORD. The prophets condemn the rich who add field to field and crush the poor (Isaiah 5:8; Amos 4:1; Micah 2:1–2).

Jesus blesses the poor and pronounces woe on the rich (Luke 6:20–26), tells of the rich fool (Luke 12:16–21) and the rich man and Lazarus (Luke 16:19–31), and says it is hard for the rich to enter the kingdom (Mark 10:23–25). Paul warns that the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil (1 Timothy 6:10), and James 5:1–6 condemns rich people who cheat their workers.
